subject.title: Define durable final fallback delivery semantics across channels

question: Should this issue remain the canonical cross-channel contract umbrella while bounded fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a complete set of mechanism-specific canonical issues?
rationale: Current main implements substantial shared foundations, but unresolved reports span pre-payload failure, unconfirmed sends, preview finalization, and restart recovery and therefore require deliberate ownership and sequencing.

options.title: Keep the umbrella
options.body: Retain this issue for the shared invariant and require each narrow fix to add or preserve common conformance coverage.

options.title: Split into canonicals
options.body: Define and link one canonical issue for every remaining mechanism before closing this umbrella.

recommendation.title: Keep the umbrella
recommendation.body: Retain this issue for the shared invariant and require each narrow fix to add or preserve common conformance coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue author defined the intended product contract, boundaries, and acceptance proof while implementation ownership is shared.
